title: Immutable state and flow compatibility
behavioral_concerns: Conformance Review is gated only by current fresh passed or passed_with_reports performance evidence when policy is enabled.
Every verification publication checks the complete durable writer token immediately before publication; stale generations cannot publish.
Flow schema v4 validates bounded performance pointers and counts while schemas v1 through v3 remain readable through migration.
Performance state strictly rejects unknown fields, trailing JSON, malformed identities, invalid references, text overflow, and counters above persisted limits.
Planning refreshes preserve existing performance summaries, while implementation mutation marks prior verification evidence stale.
Private records are contained, no-follow, permission-restricted, immutable, digest-verified, and rejected on conflicting bytes.
The performance phase remains outside planning-stage compatibility and shared verification ownership does not regress QA or repair publication.

evidence.summary: The cited failure path calls PublishState, then LoadFlowState and SaveFlowState without a writer-fence check immediately before flow-state publication.

theories.claim: The performance failure path can publish a flow-state summary after its verification writer token becomes stale because it does not recheck the writer fence immediately before SaveFlowState.
theories.basis: qa-v1-block-68cfca988b5aef1e551fa430 shows PublishState followed by LoadFlowState and SaveFlowState without another writer check; qa-v1-block-26f674a3d24b675fa55b8463 defines the complete shared verification writer token.
theories.confirmation_condition: Ownership can change after PublishState checks the token and before finishPerformanceFailure calls SaveFlowState, allowing the stale generation to modify durable flow state.
theories.refutation_condition: SaveFlowState performs the complete verification writer-token check immediately before publication, or a cited ownership guarantee proves the generation cannot change during this interval.
theories.inconclusive_condition: The ownership lifecycle or SaveFlowState behavior differs from the cited source and available evidence cannot establish whether ownership can change across the interval.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Use a deterministic product-owned fence hook that advances the generation after PublishState and before SaveFlowState, then inspect whether the stale failure path changes durable flow state.
